source: US Census 2020 decennial (P1 total population, H1 housing units) via TIGERweb tigerWMS_Census2020 layer 10
note: Summary level 100 — one level finer than the block groups in population.json, and an enumeration rather than a survey estimate, so these counts carry no margin of error. Vintage 2020 is the last decennial before 2025-01-07; a later census would describe the place after the event. Hazard arrival is the first perimeter frame containing the block centroid, so a large block reads as reached when its middle is reached.
